- **Total spent**:"},{"id":"p17s5","text":" uses an accounting-based percentage after an invoice import; otherwise falls back to the Harness lo"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"cal estimate.

price maps are configurable."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The fold is deterministic and independent of when you look at it:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- A usage sample replaces the earlier sample of the same `(turn, step)` instead of double-counting i"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"t; `llm/retry-started` closes the matching slot so a retry keeps the cost of the attempt it replaced"},{"id":"p29s3","text":".

- Day buckets a"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"nd the Today/7-day/30-day windows all use `2026-08-17`-style UTC+08:00 dates. - Token fields accept only nonnegative safe integer"},{"id":"p29s9","text":"s (or their numeric strings); malformed values become zero, and cache reads are never subtracted fro"},{"id":"p29s10","text":"m `inputTokens`.
